The White House nominated Nathan Anonick of Virginia as a Commissioner of the Commodity Futures Trading Commission.
Anonick's nomination would fill the seat held by Rostin Behnam, whose term has expired.
The White House also nominated Kristin N. Johnson of Michigan as a Member of the Securities and Exchange Commission.
